items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Alberto Iznaga left the band... we wasn't - there was no way out... One of the guys in your band... was Alberto Iznaga... became La Siboney, under Alberto Iznaga direction.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. You had Jose Budet?
Jose Budet, ah, Johnny Nieto, he wasn't from Siboney but got together because Alberto Iznaga left the band and —
What about that trumpet player that was very good, Rene Ederia?
